{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:36.506169Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:36.505988Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:37.491710Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:37.490442Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:37.493819Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:37.493133Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.598102Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.597633Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.600897Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.600612Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.608865Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.608456Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.611189Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.610601Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.632782Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.632385Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.985\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.984\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     1029.\n",
      "Date:                Tue, 10 Nov 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           3.73e-42\n",
      "Time:                        14:12:39   Log-Likelihood:                 6.3835\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                            -4.767\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             2.881\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          5.2035      0.076     68.758      0.000       5.051       5.356\n",
      "x1             0.4610      0.012     39.494      0.000       0.437       0.484\n",
      "x2             0.4672      0.046     10.182      0.000       0.375       0.560\n",
      "x3            -0.0175      0.001    -17.044      0.000      -0.020      -0.015\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        1.489   Durbin-Watson:                   2.472\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.475   Jarque-Bera (JB):                1.484\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.357   Prob(JB):                        0.476\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.551   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.634779Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.634612Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.640678Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.640317Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.76685685  5.2088119   5.61448244  5.958409    6.22432027  6.40780649\n",
      "  6.51704393  6.57145155  6.59850053  6.62920082  6.69300632  6.81297566\n",
      "  7.00198373  7.2606064   7.57702588  7.92897238  8.28738292  8.62117635\n",
      "  8.90235987  9.11062817  9.23669954  9.28384081  9.26733065  9.21194931\n",
      "  9.14790728  9.10588184  9.1119768   9.18343379  9.32579945  9.53201418\n",
      "  9.78357197 10.05356092 10.31108477 10.52633906 10.67550795 10.74467708\n",
      " 10.73211962 10.64858006 10.51550886 10.36153822 10.2177779  10.11270395\n",
      " 10.06748021 10.09248111 10.18558722 10.33253345 10.50925274 10.68583025\n",
      " 10.83141827 10.91930439]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.643027Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.642419Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.649564Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.649224Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.92260859 10.80316653 10.57929821 10.29275263  9.99848616  9.75120731\n",
      "  9.59198218  9.53818002  9.57922068  9.67916495]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.653713Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.651350Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.991774Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.991356Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x78775347aba0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.995404Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:39.994795Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.006687Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.006329Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.008620Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.008448Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.018175Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.017326Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           5.203520\n",
       "x1                  0.460963\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.467154\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.017467\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.019643Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.019471Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.027501Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T14:12:40.026676Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.922609\n",
       "1    10.803167\n",
       "2    10.579298\n",
       "3    10.292753\n",
       "4     9.998486\n",
       "5     9.751207\n",
       "6     9.591982\n",
       "7     9.538180\n",
       "8     9.579221\n",
       "9     9.679165\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
